name: Sales Lead Intake
description: Human-in-the-loop sales workflow for signals from Telegram lead chats. Sasuke triages the incoming signal, the sales owner reviews it, prepares a content proposal, requests an estimate, and assembles the commercial proposal/follow-up. This replaces hardcoded Sasuke reminders with explicit workflow state.

elements.label: Triage lead signal
elements.intent: Classify the Telegram signal, summarize customer need, extract company/contact/source metadata, and decide whether it should enter the sales funnel.

elements.label: Review lead and decide next step
elements.intent: Human review: confirm whether the lead is worth processing, add missing context, and choose the next sales action.

elements.label: Prepare content proposal
elements.intent: Prepare the meaningful proposal: problem framing, value hypothesis, scope outline, discovery questions, and assumptions.

elements.label: Prepare estimate request
elements.intent: Translate the content proposal into an estimate request for PM/tech review: scope, deliverables, risks, and questions.

elements.label: Assemble commercial proposal and follow-up
elements.intent: Assemble the commercial proposal or next follow-up: pricing input, open questions, client-facing summary, and next action.
